PAYC.physical_anchor: none — cloud payroll/HR software platform, no physical product
PAYC.value_chain_position: SaaS provider of cloud-based human capital management (payroll, HR, benefits) software; a pure software platform with no physical chain product.

PAYO.physical_anchor: none — cross-border digital payments and fintech infrastructure platform
PAYO.value_chain_position: digital payments network for cross-border commerce and marketplace sellers; the textbook anti-Visa case — a payments network never carries a physical anchor.

PAYP.physical_anchor: none — Japanese mobile QR-code payments and financial super-app platform
PAYP.value_chain_position: mobile payments/e-wallet super-app (Japan); a payments network with no physical anchor, same category error as PAYO.

PCAR.physical_anchor: manufactures Class-8 heavy-duty trucks (Kenworth, Peterbilt, DAF) and diesel/natural-gas engines
PCAR.value_chain_position: commercial-truck OEM and powertrain manufacturer; a real physical anchor but not a grid/nuclear/power/robotics chain participant — the broad Industrial-Machinery filter mis-caught a truck maker.

PCOR.value_chain_position: SaaS platform for construction project/financial management; software only, no physical product.

PCTY.physical_anchor: none — cloud payroll/HR software platform, no physical product
PCTY.value_chain_position: SaaS provider of cloud-based HR/payroll software; same category as PAYC — pure software, no physical chain product.

PDFS.physical_anchor: none — sells yield-analytics software and IP licenses to semiconductor fabs, does not itself manufacture hardware
PDFS.value_chain_position: semiconductor yield-management software and characterization-IP licensing; analytics layer, not a physical quantum-hardware maker.

PEGA.value_chain_position: enterprise low-code/CRM software vendor; no physical product.

PEN.physical_anchor: manufactures catheter-based mechanical thrombectomy and aspiration devices, including computer-controlled vascular intervention platforms (e.g., Lightning aspiration system)
PEN.value_chain_position: surgical/interventional robotics layer — physical thrombectomy hardware and computer-assisted vascular intervention systems sold into hospital procedure volume.

PH.physical_anchor: manufactures precision motion-control and fluid-power components — hydraulics, pneumatics, electromechanical actuators, and filtration systems
PH.value_chain_position: motion control & actuators layer — engineered components sold into industrial automation, aerospace, and robotics OEM builds.

PHG.physical_anchor: manufactures diagnostic imaging equipment (MRI, CT, ultrasound) and image-guided interventional therapy systems
PHG.value_chain_position: diversified medtech conglomerate (imaging, patient monitoring, personal health); a real device maker but a general medtech, not a genuine surgical-robotics chain participant.

PLAB.physical_anchor: manufactures photomasks — the physical lithography templates used to print circuit patterns onto semiconductor and flat-panel-display wafers
PLAB.value_chain_position: photomask manufacturer supplying the broad semiconductor/FPD industry; a generic semis supply-chain name caught by the quantum filter, not quantum-specific hardware.

PLTR.physical_anchor: none — enterprise/government data-analytics and AI software platform (Foundry, Gotham, AIP), no physical hardware
PLTR.value_chain_position: AI/data-fusion software platform; the textbook anti-Visa case for the quantum industry-keyword filter — software with no physical anchor.

PLXS.physical_anchor: contract manufacturer that designs and builds complex electronic assemblies and circuit boards for industrial, aerospace/defense, and healthcare customers
PLXS.value_chain_position: diversified electronics-manufacturing-services (EMS) provider; a real physical anchor but spread across many end-markets rather than monetizing one FDT chain's demand curve.

PNR.physical_anchor: manufactures water treatment, filtration, and pool/pump equipment
PNR.value_chain_position: industrial/residential water-treatment and filtration equipment maker; not a grid/nuclear/power/robotics chain participant despite the Industrial-Machinery filter catch.

PODD.physical_anchor: manufactures tubeless wearable insulin-delivery pump devices (Omnipod)
PODD.value_chain_position: diabetes-device maker (wearable insulin pump hardware); a real medical device but not a surgical-robotics/automation chain participant.

POWI.physical_anchor: designs and fabs high-voltage semiconductor ICs for AC-DC and motor-drive power conversion
POWI.value_chain_position: power-conversion semiconductor maker (chargers, appliances, EV/industrial power supplies); a generic power-semis name caught by the broad Semiconductors filter, not quantum control electronics.

POWL.physical_anchor: manufactures medium/high-voltage switchgear, motor control centers, and integrated power-control room systems
POWL.value_chain_position: transformers & switchgear layer — a named taxonomy anchor_example; sells electrical distribution/protection equipment into utility, industrial, and datacenter customers.

PRIM.physical_anchor: builds and installs physical power-delivery, pipeline, and utility-scale renewable-energy infrastructure as an EPC contractor
PRIM.value_chain_position: grid EPC & interconnection layer — construction contractor delivering transmission, substation, and utility-scale power projects, the same slot the taxonomy notes assign to Quanta Services (PWR).

PSIX.physical_anchor: designs and manufactures internal-combustion engines and natural-gas/propane power-generation systems (gensets)
PSIX.value_chain_position: turbines & generation equipment layer — engine/genset maker supplying backup and prime power, including emerging behind-the-meter datacenter power-generation demand.
